title: Jacob didn’t multiply his flocks by accident.
paragraphs:
Jacob didn’t multiply his flocks by accident.
He watched. He learned. He acted wisely.

Growth without wisdom destroys what you build.
But stewardship turns small things into abundance.
Are you multiplying… or just hoping?

God may give increase.
But wisdom decides what survives it.

People want sudden blessing.
But Scripture shows something different.

Jacob worked patiently.
Observed patterns.
Stewarded what he had.

Fast growth impresses people.
Wise growth sustains it.

Multiplication is a blessing.
Stewardship determines if it lasts.
